name: Repeat Dance Records
description: Full-stack vinyl storefront on the Discogs API — 13-currency checkout, artist and category taxonomy, media embeds and a recommendation engine. Set the architecture pattern reused across every later commerce build.

name: Chrome Furniture
description: Premium storefront with supplier API integration and an automated image-processing pipeline, plus an order-management backend and the Power BI revenue and expense model that became the reporting layer.

name: Meridian
description: Open-source execution engine bridging Crypto.com and Alpaca — configurable strategy parameters, automated order logic and risk limits across crypto and equities. Published for public review.

name: Orbis
description: Browser-based editor for spherical and 360° footage aimed at creators, real-estate and travel media. GPU rendering pipeline in WebGL and Three.js over a Python processing backend.

name: Tabiji
description: Location-aware trip planner that ingests Google Maps saved-place exports into a normalised itinerary model covering routes, filming locations, food logs and inventory.

name: Horizon IT
description: Integration layer unifying Lightspeed POS, Deputy workforce management and NowBookIt bookings for a multi-site hospitality client — API contracts, sync orchestration and one reporting schema across three vendors.

name: Parker AI
description: Conversational Japanese tutor chaining real-time speech recognition (Deepgram Nova-3) into LLM response generation (Claude), with pronunciation scoring, a JLPT-aligned curriculum and spaced repetition.
